आक्षेप प्र ाप्त हु ए र्े , सक्षम अजधकारी द्व ारा उन आक्षेपो दक सुनवाई दक गयी एवं उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20ड के अनुसार मे आिेि पाररत कर दिये गए हे | और, उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20ड की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी ने अपनी ररपोटड केंरीय सरकार को प्रस्ट् तुत कर िी है I अतः अब केंरीय सरकार, सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी से उक्त ररपोटड के प्र ाप्त होने पर और उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20ड की उपधारा (1) द्व ारा प्र ित िजक्तयों का प्र योग करते हु ए , यह घोषण करती है दक इससे उपाबि अनुसूची मे जवजनर्िडष्ट भूजम पूवोक्त प्र योिन के जलए अर्िडत की िाएगी I और यह दक केंरीय सरकार उक्त अजधजनयम दक धारा 20ड दक उप -धारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है दक रािपत्र मे इस अजधसूचना के प्र काजित होने पर इससे उपाबि अनुसूची में जवजनर्िडष्ट भूजम सभी जवलंगमों से मुक्त होकर केंरीय सरकार मे आतयांदकत रू प से जनजहत हो िा एगी I 2025, The Para Mentioned Below Should Be Treated As Corrected Details In Previous Notification) Mumbai, the 29th April, 2026 Under clause 20E of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 S.O. 2196(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Railways (Railway Board), number, S.O 2498 (E) dated 3rd June 2025 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub- section (ii), dated the 6th June 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification ) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railway Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) and Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special -- 3 of 5 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] Railway Project, namely “Proposed Construction of ROB & RUB (10 Nos.) in lieu of Level Crossing Gates between Igatpuri-Manmad & Bhusawal-Badnera Section of Bhusawal Divison” in the district of Nashik in the State of Maharashtra. And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in for Asst. Collector and Sub Divisional Officer, Nashik in daily newspapers namely “Dainik Maharashtra Times” & “Dainik Lokmat Times” dated 01-08-2025 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. And whereas, objections were received. Competent Authority has heard the objections and orders have been passed in terms of Section D of the said act. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of Section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government. Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub- section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances SCHEDULE Brief description of the land to be acquired, with or without structures, falling within the Special Railway Project of “Proposed Construction of ROB & RUB (10 Nos.) in lieu of Level Crossing Gates between Igatpuri-Manmad & Bhusawal-Badnera Section of Bhusawal Divison” (LC 93A) in the District Nashik in the State of Maharashtra.
